headline: As of 2026-10-20: 12,194,080 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+17.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 12,194,080 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+17.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,523,009), Florida (1,180,026), Georgia (1,040,915).
